searchText: Do you need help with updating BLS tests? A PR for https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/8945 in EELS and another one in EEST is absolutely welcome 😄 Ok, can I start with EEST first? Yes of course We are adding a generic precompile absence check test in this PR, so we should be covered in case someone forgets to remove the precompile from their implementation: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/pull/1036 So it's only a matter of removing the precompile checks and tests Great. But we don't have to remove the tests: you can redirect all MUL tests to MSM precompiles... (and potentially find and remove duplicates) Sounds like a plan 😄 I'll be merging https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/pull/1032 in a little bit, which directly affects BLS tests Ok, my commitment for tomorrow: 1. Implement gas changes in evmone. 2. Check https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/pull/1032. 3. Remove MUL in EEST. The EELS change can be done in parallel MUL removal MVP: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/pull/1039
